style.backgroundSystem: seamless white packshot field alternating with cool light-grey studio panels #E6E8EB and a clean concrete jobsite horizon
style.iconSystem: consistent thin-line circular icons, one cyan accent #17A2B8, long-soft shadow, same stroke weight
style.lightingSystem: neutral-cool studio light, front-left key with fill card, soft contact shadow grounding the shell, consistent direction across the set
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium industrial-PPE ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean light-grey studio background #E6E8EB, deep charcoal text #2D2D2D, safety-yellow product accent #F2B50C, and one cool cyan secondary accent #17A2B8; neutral-cool studio lighting; modern geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line circular icon style; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: keep the molded dome, brim and vent row identical across every shot; stable 3/4 hero angle; consistent scale and centering
style.surfaceSystem: matte light-grey studio surface, glossy molded ABS shell, real concrete rooftop and jobsite steel
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; short three-layer in-image copy wrapped in 「」, headline <=15 chars, 2-4 short labels, no dense body text
